description: Rich semantic symbol map: maps domain tokens (particles/abstract concepts) to metadata used by the listener, dashboard, and promotion tools.
author: pcrosby-1990

electron.notes: Represents negative charge / motion disturbances; used to indicate small, fast changes in the corridor.

photon.notes: Symbolizes release of energy or insight; triggers light/cathartic UI cues and logging.

gluon.notes: Used to indicate binding/aggregation events in the system (linking items together, strengthening memory/corridor coherence).

neutrino.notes: Very light-weight signal; low-impact background event useful for telemetry or hidden traces.

photon_release_boost.notes: Higher-intensity variant of photon for stronger release events (UI sparkle/celebration).

electron_swirl.notes: A variant used when motion is swirling/unstable; maps to same char as electron but different semantic effect.

binder_lock.notes: Represents an enforced binding or persistent memory cohesion (stronger than gluon).

catharsis_wave.notes: A broader release effect that affects multiple downstream components (broadcast style).

entropy_spike.notes: High-entropy, high-impact motion event. Often requires conflict resolution or dampening.

memory_anchor.notes: Anchors memory or state to stable baseline; useful when binding must persist across restarts.
